title: PROTEUS Responsible AI Guideline
description:
Responsible AI guideline of the Horizon Europe project PROTEUS – The Copernicus Agent for Next-Generation Environmental Intelligence. It sets out principles, a lifecycle checklist and roles and responsibilities for the trustworthy development and use of agentic AI on Copernicus Earth Observation data.

Website: https://aldinorizaldy.github.io/proteus_rai_guideline/
